artifact: F-5.1 ontology decision, target model, consumers, identity, migration and zero-cost results (mission §4-§12, §15)
architecturalInvariant: Pass A inventory identity represents WHAT SOURCE SEMANTIC EXISTS (slot + coordination position + span cluster + values), never which one of several overlapping labels the model happened to pick. A classification label is an ATTRIBUTE of an item. Real semantic differences are not hidden: distinct source ownership (different start / disjoint span / different values) and contradictory deontic effects always remain distinct identities.

authoritativeSemanticModel.before: SemanticInventoryItem.semanticRole: one mutually-exclusive scalar from 17 roles; identity-bearing (computeInventoryItemId(candidateRef, role, regionId, slotId, coordination, values, ordinal)); base key for merging included the role.
authoritativeSemanticModel.after: SemanticInventoryItem.semanticFunctions (AUTHORITATIVE): { effect: PERMISSION|PROHIBITION|REQUIREMENT|DEFINITIONAL|NONE (scalar, mutually exclusive by construction); logic: subset of {CONDITION, EXCEPTION, TRIGGER, ALTERNATIVE, CURE, RECLASSIFICATION}; quantitative: subset of {VALUE, FORMULA_COMPONENT, THRESHOLD, TIME_PERIOD}; dependency: subset of {REFERENCE, DEPENDENCY, SHARED_CAP} } = union of the declared roles' functions + deterministic source-structure additions. declaredRoles keeps every label the model gave (primary first; union across merged duplicates). functionProvenance records which tokens were declared and which were deterministic. semanticRole is RETAINED as a derived compatibility field (deriveLegacyRole: the declared primary when consistent with the canonical set, else fixed precedence).
authoritativeSemanticModel.justificationFromMatrix: every observed identical-span conflict crosses exactly these dimension boundaries (logic x quantitative: ALTERNATIVE/FORMULA_COMPONENT 16, CONDITION/FORMULA_COMPONENT 12, ALTERNATIVE/THRESHOLD 2, THRESHOLD/VALUE 1 within quantitative; logic x effect: CONDITION/PERMISSION 5, ALTERNATIVE/PERMISSION 5, EXCEPTION/PERMISSION 3, CONDITION/PROHIBITION 2; logic x logic: CONDITION/EXCEPTION 5, ALTERNATIVE/CONDITION 5, CONDITION/TRIGGER 1 - sets, not scalars; logic x dependency: CONDITION/REFERENCE 3; dependency x dependency: REFERENCE/DEPENDENCY 2). Four dimensions are the minimum that separate every observed pair; effect stays scalar because no identical-span PERMISSION/PROHIBITION/REQUIREMENT conflict was observed and such a conflict is a genuine two-proposition signal.
authoritativeSemanticModel.noCovenantFamilyRoles: no RP_BASKET / DEBT_BASKET / LEVERAGE_TEST / AVAILABLE_AMOUNT_COMPONENT / CHEWY_* - the vocabulary is unchanged; only its structure changed. DEFINITIONAL is an effect value reserved for structural callers and is NOT derived from the model's operative flag (measured: that flag varied on 75 of 344 aligned items).

rulesAddOnly: explicit citation in the span (Section/§/clause/Schedule/Annex/Exhibit/Article + number) or a listed referencedSection -> dependency:REFERENCE
stated number + comparator in the span (not to exceed / less than / at least / in excess of / ...) -> quantitative:THRESHOLD
a span that IS the number (<= 3 words of residue), or a valued span with no quantitative function -> quantitative:VALUE

selector in the span (the greater/lesser/lower/... of, either) -> logic:ALTERNATIVE (the selection); a span hanging from a selector earlier in the same slot with no clause break between -> logic:ALTERNATIVE (a branch)
condition opener at span start (provided [that], so long as, if, subject to, to the extent, unless, in the event that) -> logic:CONDITION
exception opener at span start (other than, except, excluding, but not including, save for) -> logic:EXCEPTION
trigger opener at span start (upon, on the occurrence of, at any time after, from and after, immediately upon) -> logic:TRIGGER
deterministicCanonicalization.neverInferred: a deontic effect (PERMISSION/PROHIBITION/REQUIREMENT) is never inferred from keywords ('shall not', 'may'); DEPENDENCY and SHARED_CAP stay model judgments; rules never remove a declared function.
deterministicCanonicalization.modelSide: prompt v5: semanticRole = primary role; additionalRoles = every other function the proposition genuinely serves (tolerant, optional, never identity-bearing). The example lists additionalRoles on the alternative branches and the condition.

identityMechanism.before: stableKey(candidateRef, role, regionId, slotId, coordinationSubIndex, clusterOrdinal, valueSignature, v4); base key = [role, regionId, slotId, coordination, valueSignature]; same-key items clustered by span (value-free: mutual overlap >= 50% of the longer; valued: containment >= 50% of the shorter).
identityMechanism.after: stableKey(candidateRef, regionId, slotId, coordinationSubIndex, clusterOrdinal, valueSignature, v5) - ROLE-BLIND; base key = [regionId, slotId, coordination, valueSignature].
falseMergeProtections: (1) contradictory deontic effects (PERMISSION vs PROHIBITION vs REQUIREMENT) never share a cluster whatever the overlap

(2) value-free: a cluster requires mutual overlap >= 50% AND the same normalized start (enumerators/coordinating connectives skipped, at most one word of slop) - a citation inside the permission it qualifies, a sub-exception inside its exception, a branch inside its selection all start elsewhere and stay their own identity (the I10 corpus scenario and tests C/F/trust-safety prove it)

(3) valued: containment >= 50% of the shorter merges only when the starts coincide OR the shorter excerpt IS the value ('$50,000,000' inside 'the greater of $50,000,000'); a value-bearing clause that starts elsewhere inside a longer value-bearing clause stays distinct (the certification pair's '(15) basket' vs its cap, the '(x) 50% of CNI' branch vs its 'greater of' selection)
(4) different values, disjoint spans and different coordination sub-indexes separate as before
identityMechanism.residualOrdinalWeakness: within one base key several clusters are numbered in source order; if one run omits an earlier cluster the later one shifts ordinal (present in v4 too; measured as part of strict stability).

migrationStrategy: A (mission §6): semanticFunctions is canonical and authoritative; semanticRole is kept as a derived compatibility field; declaredRoles preserved for transparency. ONE authoritative identity per source proposition (role-blind key).

zeroCostReplayOfTheCertificationPair.proxyOnly: replays the v4 inventories (their verified excerpts, declared roles, values, parent links) through the v5 normalizer without a model call; cannot show what the v5 prompt elicits; never used to certify
zeroCostReplayOfTheCertificationPair.falseMergeCandidateInspection: runA flagged 1 (DEPENDENCY 'Threshold Amount' [2427,2443] + THRESHOLD 'Threshold Amount' [2427,2444]): same words, one proposition described as a dependency and as the threshold - a correct merge, flagged only because the two propositions' wordings share few tokens. runB flagged 0.

antiGaming.representationVsOntology: Scoring the UNCHANGED v4 inventories with a label-blind matcher already lifts semantic stability from 0.5251 to 0.8426 and critical/material from 0.5236 to 0.8321: that is the part of the improvement that is 'representation' - and it is exactly the measured ontology ambiguity (90 of 337 aligned pairs differ only in label; 87 adjudicated A/B). The part that is a real IDENTITY change is strict stability: 0.501 -> 0.8101 on the same evidence, from making the key role-blind with the start/value/effect guards (4 merges per run, 0 lost items, 0 lost values). What the ontology does NOT fix is visible in both representations: the residual run-only substantive items (28/32) are decomposition and omission differences (the certification's F/B/H classes), and the per-dimension function agreement (logic 0.79, quantitative 0.83) shows the model still describes the same proposition's functions differently one time in five - an attribute variance that no longer manufactures identities.
antiGaming.legacyMetricRetained: scripts/f5-1-canonical-score.py always emits legacyDerivedRole and legacyDeclaredRole blocks with the frozen definition; scripts/f5-align-runs.py is untouched and still runs on v5 output.

sameRootReplay.reading: 33 recorded inventories (v3-era evidence, segment-fallback slots): 72 role-conflict pairs, of which 1 has an identical span and was canonicalized into one identity; the other 71 are nested or differently-bounded propositions and stay distinct (0 false-merge candidates); 0 items lost, 0 values lost, 0 materiality changes, 0 records with a coverage change; 7 parent links resolved onto merged duplicates (self-loops removed); 521 items gained a deterministic structural function.

gapPass: NOT modified. The gap pass re-presents unaccounted slots and its additions pass through the same v5 normalization, so a gap item that re-describes an existing proposition with another label now merges into it instead of creating a role-specific duplicate. Its variance (which slots remain unaccounted after the first pass) is a different root cause and is measured, not fixed, in the paid pair (mission §10).
